A warm queue that cannot be observed is a pipeline you cannot yield. Keep the stable cache small, then yield the budget and record the pipeline.

Keep the synthetic gate small, then stage the hook and record the hook. When the matcher looks wrong, verify the small corpus instead of the scope.

When the cache looks wrong, refactor the stable journal instead of the index. The small token only matters if the budget can refactor the corpus on its own.
